'''Chaw Troillya''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] and [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who operated near [[Mos Taike/Legends|Mos Taike]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Chaw Troillya was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
